# Nano Empire AI

> Machine-payable US & Canadian product-recall data (RecallGuard, paid per call in USDC on Base via x402), cryptographic SkillProof Trust Manifests & MCP pre-audit scorecards (complementing ERC-8004 / A2A identity), and BidShield pre-action compliance gates for federal solicitations and AP2 Human-Not-Present mandates.

Updated: 2026-11-08

Contact: rob@nanoempireai.com

## Architecture & Agent Operating Model (Nov 2026 Stack)

- Single Main Agent Loop with progressive disclosure of skills and tools. Nano Empire exposes atomic tools via Streamable HTTP MCP (`/api/mcp`), JSON verification gates (`/api/skillproof/status`, `/api/bidshield/gate`), and `x402` endpoints rather than requiring multi-agent overhead for linear tasks.
- Cryptographic Proof Layer (`SkillProof` + `BidShield`): While `ERC-8004` (~2M+ identities) and `A2A` v1.0 Agent Cards establish *who* an agent is, and `x402` v2 / `MPP` / `AP4M` handle settlement, Nano Empire verifies *behavioral execution boundaries* (Ed25519 Trust Manifests pinned to commit `tree_sha`) and *pre-action solicitation compliance* (quantified Decision Exposure / JEV).
- Complete M2M briefing and protocol synthesis (Nov 6, 2026): https://www.nanoempireai.com/m2m-state.md

## Live: machine endpoints (x402, MCP, & Cryptographic Proof Gates)

- RecallGuard Health (free): GET https://recallguard-api.vercel.app/api/v1/health
- RecallGuard Feed, $0.05 USDC per call (x402 on Base): GET https://recallguard-api.vercel.app/api/v1/feed?limit=50
  Returns 46,642 normalized US & Canadian (CPSC, FDA & Health Canada) recall records. Unpaid calls return HTTP 402.
- RecallGuard Match, $0.10 USDC per call (x402 on Base): POST https://recallguard-api.vercel.app/api/v1/match
  Input: {"items":[{"name":"string","brand":"string","upc":"string"}]}
  Output: {"matches":[{"recall_id":"string","severity":"string","hazard":"string","remedy":"string"}]}
  Unpaid calls return HTTP 402.
- Streamable HTTP MCP Server (5 live tools): POST https://www.nanoempireai.com/api/mcp
  Tools: `recallradar_check_product`, `recallradar_audit_manifest_info`, `skillproof_verify_repo`, `bidshield_triage_info`, `bidshield_evaluate_solicitation_gate`
- SkillProof Pre-Audit Status & Ed25519 Verification Gate (free JSON): GET https://www.nanoempireai.com/api/skillproof/status?repo=owner/repo
  Returns `skillproof_score`, commit `tree_sha`, line-cited findings, `delegation_recommendation` (`ALLOW_BOUNDED` / `CONDITIONAL_SANDBOX_ONLY` / `HALT_HIGH_RISK`), and Ed25519 public key (`kid: skillproof-2026-10`).
- SkillProof Live Repository Scanner: POST https://www.nanoempireai.com/api/skillproof/preaudit
  Input: {"repo":"owner/repo"}
- BidShield Pre-Action Compliance Gate (free preliminary JSON gate): POST https://www.nanoempireai.com/api/bidshield/gate
  Input: {"solicitation_text":"string","naics_code":"238220","estimated_contract_value_usd":250000}
  Output: `gate_decision` (`PASS_PRELIMINARY` / `CONDITIONAL_HUMAN_REVIEW` / `HALT_FATAL_DISQUALIFIER`), `ap2_mandate_recommendation`, `quantified_decision_exposure_jev_usd`, and triggered fatal clause traps.

## Payment terms & Cryptographic Keys

- Protocol: x402 v2 (HTTP 402 challenge, pay, retry; `PAYMENT-REQUIRED` / `PAYMENT-SIGNATURE` / `X-PAYMENT-RESPONSE`)
- Network: base (EIP-155:8453)
- Asset (Base USDC): 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913
- Pay to: 0x90E23A7b6F6494A879d05DDC4278D0e55Dec1e01
- Facilitator: coinbase-x402-facilitator
